We need to fix compilation errors. The test class uses JUnit 5 annotations like @BeforeEach, @AfterEach, @DisplayName, @Test, and MockitoExtension. However the environment likely doesn't have those dependencies. Since we just need code to compile, we can remove those imports and annotations, and adjust accordingly. Also the custom assertTrue/False methods have wrong signatures: they accept (boolean condition, String message) but implementation incorrectly calls itself recursively causing stack overflow. Should fix: implement proper assertTrue/assertFalse that ignore message or use message.

Also the test methods are annotated with @Test etc but we can keep them as plain methods (no need for annotations). Remove import statements for JUnit and Mockito. Also remove @ExtendWith annotation.

Also the custom assertTrue method currently calls itself causing infinite recursion. Should be:

private static void assertTrue(boolean condition, String message) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message); }

Similarly for assertFalse.

Also there were overloaded methods used without message; they call assertTrue(condition) which expects two params. In code they call assertTrue(closedPosition.isClosed()); without message. That fails compile. We can add overloaded methods without message, or change calls to include message. Simpler: add overloaded versions:

private static void assertTrue(boolean condition) { assertTrue(condition, "expected true but was false"); }

private static void assertFalse(boolean condition) { assertFalse(condition, "expected false but was true"); }

And keep the two-arg versions.

Also the test class uses JUnit @Test annotation; we can keep but need import. However we can just remove annotations and keep methods. Since main runs test methods directly, they don't need annotations. So we can delete @Test, @DisplayName, @BeforeEach, @AfterEach, @ExtendWith, and imports.

Also there is duplicate setup methods: @BeforeEach method and private setup method. We can keep only private setup and teardown; but the @BeforeEach method will cause compile errors due to missing annotation. So remove that method.

Thus final code: package same; imports only needed ones: org.ta4j.core.Trade.TradeType; org.ta4j.core.analysis.cost.CostModel; org.ta4j.core.analysis.cost.ZeroCostModel; org.ta4j.core.num.DoubleNum; org.ta4j.core.num.Num; java.lang.reflect.Field; maybe no others.

Remove org.junit.* imports.
